text.tspan: aurora_editor — Standalone desktop application (built with Dioxus)
for browsing and editing Aurora models, including live validation and
Aurora Model Source Files — Aurora model source-of-truth files
stored as JSJSON: a mission card plus per-card files under
Dioxus App Shell — Top-level Dioxus component that owns the UI
shell layout and routes focus/selection changes between panes.
Explorer Tree Pane — Left navigation pane that presents a tree view
derived from shortest paths from the mission root, enabling fast card
Brain Graph Pane — Central pane that renders a mind-map /
TheBrain-style context graph with the focused card centered and related
Inspector Pane — Right pane that splits vertically: top half edits
the focused card; bottom half shows a rendered Markdown-style preview
(and links) with a tab to reveal audit details.
Model Session and Persistence — In-memory model session that loads a
workspace model home, computes shortest paths, validates changes, and
persists updated card files using aurora_shared semantics.
Workspace File System — Filesystem-backed store holding Aurora model
source files (Mission card plus per-card JSJSON files) within a
Three Pane Shell — Render the editor UI as three primary panes:
left navigation tree, central context graph, and right inspector
Compute Shortest Path Tree — Compute a stable shortest-path parent for
each card from the mission root and present it as a tree for navigation
Brain Style Graph View — Render a TheBrain-like local context view:
focused card centered; show parent from the chosen shortest-path
chain; show siblings (same card_type) as adjacent nodes linked from
the parent; show focused card’s outgoing links as navigable
Card Inspector Editing — Edit the focused card’s core fields
(name, description, type/subtype, status, attributes, and links)
Preview and Audit Panel — Render a Markdown-style card preview
(including outgoing link list) and provide a tab to display audit trail
Load, Validate, and Save Models — Load Aurora models from a chosen
workspace, validate invariants on every change, and persist edits back
to JSJSON card files using shared aurora_shared semantics.
Dioxus UI Framework API — UI framework interface used to declare
layouts, render widgets, and process user events for the standalone
aurora_shared Domain API — Public domain interface (Rust API) for
discovering model homes, loading cards, validating invariants, and
Local Filesystem API — Contract for reading and writing
Aurora model files on the local filesystem (open, read, write,
